excluded_scopes: All .git directories, caches, virtual environments, compiler/build directories and binary artifacts, except exact files explicitly required by frozen manifests (small probe-id NPY arrays and four pytest cache metadata files in each baseline experiment).
Nested model .gitattributes omitted; handoff root uses ** -text to preserve frozen bytes.
LBM arm_env: conda_pkgs, llvm20, taichi_source, venv, wheels, pilot data, logs and install raw output excluded.

LBM upstream: only required Single_phase solver, README, requirements and LICENSE copied; clone the original upstream repository at pinned commit for new generation because the unchanged wrapper verifies its Git history.
No raw simulation datasets or training checkpoints are part of this source inventory; result manifests are handled separately.

credential_scan.limitation: Pattern scan, not an exhaustive secret audit.
